query:
SELECT 
  s.id,
  s.saleDate,
  DATE(s.saleDate) as dateOnly,
  DAYOFMONTH(s.saleDate) as dayNumber,
  s.createdAt
FROM sales s
WHERE s.id IN (13620026, 13620024, 13620015)
ORDER BY s.id;
